note: The Phase 3 geometry case matrix.  One entry per case that tests/PhysicsGeometryTests.cpp runs, carrying the exact input words it passes and the return value and output bytes the shipped oracle produced for them.  The oracle values are a record, not an expectation the harness checks: the gate is run_differential.ps1 comparing the two transcripts.  tools/tests/test_geometry_cases.py holds this file to the committed oracle transcript so it cannot drift from what the harness actually ran.
